summary: Implemented T106 by constraining robustness analysis to the T068 strategy registry's parameter schema. Added a new schema-bound parameter surface module (`robinhood_lp.robustness.schema_binding`) that builds axes from the exact registered identity and parameter-schema revision recorded by the T105 manifest, validates every axis value against the schema's declared type / unit / range, and carries the registry / schema identity, version, and checksum with the surface. Added a new schema-bound robustness report (`SchemaBoundRobustnessReport`, version `t106.robustness_reports.v1`) that records the binding and rejects a legacy T064 `ParameterSurface` from the current publication path. Added a new schema-bound runner (`SchemaBoundRobustnessRunner`, version `t106.robustness_runner.v1`) that rejects a legacy surface and produces the schema-bound report. The legacy T064 surface / runner / report paths remain intact for the legacy artifact reader / test path, preserving all T064 acceptance clauses (every T064 test still passes). Comprehensive coverage in `tests/test_robustness_t106.py` (106 tests) exercises positive construction, boundary edges, negative cases (undeclared, wrong-type, wrong-unit, out-of-range, bool masquerading as int, duplicate axes, non-empty vs empty strings), schema-revision incompatibility, registry-binding compatibility, the heterogeneous-strategy requirement (`IDENTITY_FIXED_WIDTH` and `IDENTITY_ADAPTIVE_RANGE`), determinism, layer purity, the old-path-unreachable guarantee, and T064 legacy preservation.
